name: Smoke Bomb Mk0
_designNote: One-time-use starter flight card. Guaranteed escape from combat. Costs 3 fatigue as the adrenaline tax. Can be saved by Cargo Webbing passive.

name: Chaff Flare
_designNote: One-time-use starter flight card. Burns 1 ammo and raises alert +4 noise. Louder escape option than Smoke Bomb. Can be saved by Cargo Webbing passive.

name: Cyanide Capsule
_designNote: Reusable flee card. Bites a cyanide capsule tooth — costs 13 HP (brutal) but always gets you out. Not consumed, so it stays in your hand. High risk, high reliability. The self_damage can kill you if HP is too low.

name: Fumbled Grab
_designNote: Consolation card for failed pickpocket attempts. Adds a little noise — theft has risk.

name: Stolen Technique
_designNote: Generic permanent-steal reward card. Represents lifted enemy technique without requiring full EATK->ACT mapping yet.

name: Ultrasonic Weapon
_designNote: Core card of Ultrasonic Feedback Chain. Burns battery per light source, shatters all bulbs, creates Sonic Ground Effect. Synergizes with Feedback Microphone for free cast.

name: Feedback Microphone
_designNote: Enabler card. Creates Resonance ground effect. Next Sonic card costs 0 battery. Doubles light-based interactions this round.

name: Battery Spill
_designNote: Creates Conductive Field. All light sources become unstable. Sets up Overload Grid combo.

name: Overload Grid
_designNote: Payoff card. For each active light source: chain lightning arcs across Conductive Ground. If 4+ lights: creates Blinding Flash (enemy accuracy -50%).

name: Prism Mine
_designNote: Plants reflective nodes on floor. Converts light sources into Stored Lumens (stacking resource). Broken bulbs on Darkened Ground count as +1 Lumen.

name: Solar Flare Step
_designNote: Consumes all Stored Lumens. Creates Radiant Ground. Damages shadow-aligned enemies based on Lumens consumed.

name: Smoke Bomb
_designNote: Creates Obscured Ground. Heavy accuracy penalty for all units. Sets up Tactical Spotlight combo for positional light control.

name: Tactical Spotlight
_designNote: Redirects all light to 1 tile. Creates Overexposed spotlight tile (enemies take +crit damage) and Shadowed non-spotlight tiles (enemies have miss chance).

name: Loop Recorder
_designNote: Stores last played tag. If Sonic tag played twice in sequence (or Loop Recorder echoes Sonic), next Sonic card is free and applies Overdrive (Sonic Ground duration +1).

name: Sabotage
_designNote: Phase 3 destroy card. Burns 1 battery, destroys the highest-damage enemy card. Consumed after use. Triggers card_killed combat event → enemy goes >:( enraged. The 'sabotage' synergyTag also enables destroy-interactability on all enemy cards for the rest of the turn via EnemyCardInteractability.

name: Recon Scan
_designNote: Phase 3 reveal card. Burns 1 battery, flips ALL enemy cards face-up for the current round. Full intel burst. Consumed after use. Pairs with Scout Scope (item reveals specific cards passively, this card reveals all at once).

name: Dark Veil
_designNote: Lighting system interaction card. Halves ambient light (darknessMultiplier *= 0.5) for 3 rounds. Massive stealth bonus + enemy accuracy penalty. Pairs with Thermal Goggles: player gets full reveal + accuracy/stealth bonuses in darkness while enemy is blind. Opposite of Flashbang.

name: Flashbang
_designNote: Opposite of Dark Veil. Burns 1 ammo, maxes ambient light for 1 round (blinding flash), reveals all enemy cards, 50% chance enemy loses their turn. Loud — generates noise. Consumed after use. Synergizes with Overload Grid (more active lights = more chain lightning).

name: Fireball
_designNote: Soft intro tier. Looks simple: deal 8, apply Burn. Hidden: 🟥+🟥→Overkill, 🟦+🟥→Steam Burst (explosion), Poison+Fire→Impact+Knockback. Player learns fire tag naturally.

name: Water Splash
_designNote: Soft intro tier. Deal 5, apply Wet. Hidden: 🟦+🟨→Electrical Surge (chain lightning), 🟦+🟥→Steam Burst. Makes enemies conductive — next electrical card gets bonus. First encounter teaches Wet+Static naturally.

name: Static Shock
_designNote: Soft intro tier. Deal 6, 20% stun. Hidden: 🟨+🟦→Chain Lightning (arcs to adjacent), 🟨 on Conductive Ground→AoE stun. Natural discovery: hit a Wet enemy with this and watch lightning chain.

name: Quick Strike
_designNote: Soft intro tier. Pure 7 damage, no frills. Hidden: 🟥x2 same turn→Overkill (ignores 30% damage reduction), 🟪+🟥→Backstab (double damage from stealth). The 'honest' attack — teaches double-ballistic Overkill naturally.

name: Poison Dart
_designNote: Soft intro tier. Apply Poison 3 turns. Hidden: Poison+Fire→Explosion (removes poison, deals AoE burst), 🟩+🟪→Stealth Cascade (next attack gains Backstab). Teaches DOT patience + combo ignition.

name: Molotov
_designNote: Intermediate tier. First DUAL-TAG card player sees. 🟩+🟥. Creates fire ground + 3-turn burn. Now player sees two tags on one card and starts noticing the pattern. 🟩+🟪→Stealth Cascade, 🟥+🟥→Overkill, 🟩+🟨→Short Circuit.

name: Taser Baton
_designNote: Intermediate tier. 🟥+🟨 dual-tag. Player experiments: Taser after Water Splash = surprise stun spike (Wet+Electrical triggers Arc Surge). Reveals that tag combos cross card boundaries. 40% stun base, but guaranteed stun on Wet targets.

name: Venom Shiv
_designNote: Intermediate tier. 🟪+🟥 dual-tag. Backstab potential (🟪+🟥→Backstab from stealth). Poison+Fire→Explosion cross-card combo. Teaches that Covert cards have offensive AND synergy value.

name: Spark Puddle
_designNote: Intermediate tier. 🟦+🟨 dual-tag. Creates conductive puddle ground. Enemies stepping in get Wet. Follow up with any electrical card for guaranteed Chain Lightning. The combo enabler — teaches ground-based setups.

name: Conceal
_designNote: Intermediate tier. 🟪+🟩 dual-tag. Grants stealth + Backstab on next attack. If followed by any Improvised card: Stealth Cascade triggers (chain stealth bonuses). Teaches Covert+Improvised synergy.

name: Smoke Screen Waltz
_designNote: Defensive status intro. Gain 2 Evasion charges (next 2 attacks miss) + Obscured Ground. In Darkness: bonus +1 Evasion. 🟪+🟩→Stealth Cascade, 🟪+🟥→Backstab bonus. Soft intro to stealth layering — player learns evasion stacking.

name: Gentleman's Feint
_designNote: Defensive engine card. Negate next attack under 10 damage. If negated: gain 1 random Improvised card. Feels classy, fuels engine. 🟩+🟪→Stealth Cascade, 🟩+🟥→Ricochet counter. Teaches reactive play — take hit, generate value.

name: Mirror Compact
_designNote: 007 gadget energy. Reflect next Ballistic or Electrical attack back at enemy. Reflected 🟨 on 🟦 target → chain lightning. Reflected 🟥 counts toward Overkill. The reflected attack inherits its tags for combo purposes — reflected electricity on a Wet enemy chains.

name: Dry Martini
_designNote: Heal 6 + remove Fear/Panic. After a kill: +2 bonus heal (shaken, not stirred). ⬛+🟪→Silent Recovery (heal without breaking stealth). Spy fantasy: composed agent sips a drink after the job.

name: Field Stitch Kit
_designNote: Basic reliable heal. Heal 4 + remove Bleed. 🟩+🟨→Adrenal Surge (+1 action next turn). Genre-familiar: every spy movie has the patching-up-in-the-safehouse moment.

name: Laser Pen
_designNote: Apply Marked: next attack deals +50% damage. Clean iconic gadget. 🟥x2→Overkill. 🟨+🟥→Ignition Mark (marked + electrical = guaranteed crit). Teaches the setup→payoff rhythm with a single-tag card.

name: Venom Ring
_designNote: Elegant assassination. Poison 4 turns. If target already Wet → double poison duration (8 turns). Poison+Fire→Explosion. 🟪+🟩→Stealth Cascade. The classic poison ring handshake — patient assassin's tool.

name: Magnetic Disruptor
_designNote: Reduce enemy accuracy for 2 turns. Surveillance enemies get disabled for 1 turn. On Conductive Ground: AoE accuracy debuff spreads. 🟨+🟦→Arc Spread. Anti-tech gadget — counters Spotter Drones and Datacenter Security.

name: Exploding Cufflink
_designNote: Premium disposable. Deal 12 damage, permanently remove self from deck. 🟥x2→Overkill. ⬛+🟪→Silent Detonation (no alert if played from stealth). Feels premium: you save it for the perfect moment. The gadget Q would disapprove of.

name: Violin Wire
_designNote: Instant execute if target below 15% HP. If fails: apply Bleed 3. Pink Panther assassination energy. Best paired with Poison Dart → whittle → execute. The wire garrote is the spy's signature finisher. Consumed on use.

name: Camera Flash
_designNote: Apply Blind 1 turn. In Darkened Ground: also apply Panic (flash in total darkness is terrifying). During Stealth Cascade: double Backstab multiplier. 🟨+🟦→Stunning Arc. The tourist's weapon — nobody suspects the camera.

name: Panther's Exit
_designNote: Smooth escape energy. Remove all debuffs + become Untargetable for 1 turn. After a kill: gain an Improvised card. The cinematic 'walk away from the explosion without looking back' card. High cost (2) but total reset + invulnerability.

name: Tag Jammer
_designNote: Universal counterspell. Costs 1 battery to disable ONE tag on the target for this turn. If that tag was about to participate in a combo, bonus 2 damage (disruption reward). Against enemy cards: suppresses their strongest synergy tag. In auto-resolve: engine skips combos involving the suppressed tag. The 'Negate' card — you spend battery to break their chain.

name: Grounding Wire
_designNote: Soft tech against electrical chains. Removes all Wet statuses (kills Arc Surge setup) + suppresses electrical tag bonuses this turn + creates Grounded Ground (electrical damage halved in area for 2 turns). Costs focus to use strategically. Doesn't HARD counter — just softens. Wet tag means it still feeds combos if you sequence it right.

name: Counter-Intel Sweep
_designNote: Anti-stealth sweeper. Burns 1 ammo to reveal ALL covert-tagged enemy cards before auto-resolve. Suppresses covert tag on enemy side (no Stealth Cascade, no Backstab). +3 damage to anything revealed this way. Ballistic tag means it feeds Overkill if paired. The loud, aggressive counter to stealth builds.

name: Containment Protocol
_designNote: The skill-based risk management card. Cancels YOUR tag risk penalties this turn (no Overexertion, no Feedback Burn, no Exposure Risk, no Instability, no Heat Score). 40% chance to redirect Instability rolls to the enemy instead. Improvised tag means it feeds Stealth Cascade and Jury Rig. The card that lets you go all-in on a tag without paying the overcommit price — but only for one turn.

name: Jab
_designNote: Intro melee card. Free punch — 0 cost entry. melee+melee→Combo Strike (chain two Jabs or Jab→Haymaker for free finishing blow + stagger). ballistic+ballistic→Overkill. Most natural discovery for new players: punch twice, get rewarded. Equivalent to Basic Shot but for hand-to-hand — the fallback melee option.

name: Haymaker
_designNote: Heavy melee punch. Jab→Haymaker fires melee+melee→Combo Strike (free 5 dmg stagger). ballistic+ballistic→Overkill for armor pierce. melee+covert→CQC Takedown if paired with a covert card before this lands. The classic one-two punch — intuitive to any player who has ever played a fighting game. Teaches: same tag twice = escalation, the core combo grammar.

name: Sleeper Hold
_designNote: Silent takedown — grab from behind and squeeze. melee+covert→CQC Takedown (execute threshold +10%, bleed 2, noise -2). melee+melee→Combo Strike (with Jab or Haymaker). covert+ballistic→Backstab from stealth. The stealth-action genre's signature move: silent choke-out. Dual-tag (melee+covert) means it self-combos for CQC Takedown and chains into every melee sequence.

name: Incendiary Round
_designNote: Fire bullet. fire+fire→Inferno (with Fireball or Molotov → spreads burn AoE to all nearby enemies + bonus damage). fire+improvised→Controlled Burn (with Molotov or Field Stitch Kit). ballistic+ballistic→Overkill. Teaching: gun+fire = fire gun. The obvious military-action-movie weapon that makes the fire ecosystem more accessible to new players. A third fire card ensures Inferno is reliably reachable in any deck with fire ambitions.

name: Frag Grenade
_designNote: Standard fragmentation grenade. explosive+aoe combo for area denial. Can be planted on enemies and manually detonated. fire+explosive = bigger boom. Planted cards: triggerable=true allows manual detonation in STR combat.

name: Pipe Bomb
_designNote: Improvised pipe bomb. Stuns enemy for 1 turn. Louder than frag grenade (noise 6). Improvised tag enables combo with other improvised cards. Can be planted and manually triggered.

name: C4 Charge
_designNote: Military-grade explosive. Massive AoE (3 tile radius), delayed 1 turn trigger. Can be planted pre-combat and detonates automatically next turn, or manually triggered. industrial tag enables factory/weapon combo. Highest damage in game but slow.
